The 237-amino-acid sequence is an **exact sequence match** to reviewed mouse MMAB (UniProt **Q9D273**), a **corrinoid adenosyltransferase**. Reviewed bovine and human MMAB proteins also show strong full-length similarity.

**Catalytic activity:** MMAB transfers an adenosyl group from ATP to reduced cobalamin, converting **cob(I)alamin to adenosylcobalamin (AdoCbl)**. A concise reaction representation is:

**cob(I)alamin + ATP → adenosylcobalamin + triphosphate**

The annotation also describes release of the enzyme-bound cofactor form and notes that MMAB can deliver AdoCbl to methylmalonyl-CoA mutase. Thus, the main reaction is cofactor synthesis/adenosylation—not the mutase reaction itself.

The result is supported by an exact sequence match to a reviewed UniProt entry; the annotation maps the activity to **EC 2.5.1.-** and **Rhea RHEA:56796**. The tool returned other corrinoid reaction candidates from homologs, but those should not be assigned to this exact protein without additional evidence.
